status: Supplementary original D2R experiments establish bounded damage behavior; exact pinned-build operation order is not certified.

source.type: Primary firsthand controlled experiments; original posts reached through wiki footnotes.
source.version: D2R, exact executable build unspecified; predates pinned3.3.93847.

method: Tester edited fixed damage, critical chance, monster groups/AI and missile ToHit, then compared repeated unmodified-versus-rank20 Slow Missiles hits. Separate physical, elemental and spell cases are described.

observations.kind: Sexton Blizzard shard; both parent/child CanSlow0

observations.author: LastCorpseResurrected
observations.result: Reported successive/multiplicative reduction rather than one additive pool.
observations.limit: No boundary/rounding matrix or exact source order supplied.

implication: Treat speed and damage as separate launch fields. CanSlow restricts speed, not all damage. Preserve duration fields; a global target health multiplier would also affect unrelated melee/DoTs and is unsupported.
limits: These are controlled edited-game experiments, not a current vanilla executable trace. Full canSlow0 eligibility, already-flying/child snapshot timing, FP256 rounding and ordering relative to critical/ED/absorb/resistance remain open.
Fire Ball child behavior was explicitly unresolved in the original discussion; no blanket inference that every parent/child receives exactly one multiplication.
This supports a candidate component, not complete Slow Missiles availability.
